content.stem: 以下哪些是使用搜索引擎进行负面媒体报道搜索的局限性？(选择三项.)

options.A: 搜索引擎在全球语言覆盖方面存在局限性
options.B: 搜索引擎提供的非结构化数据使媒体分析变得复杂
options.C: 搜索结果在识别相关负面媒体报道方面往往效率低下
options.D: 这个过程耗时且需要大量的人工投入.
options.E: 由于搜索引擎算法的不同,结果可能会不一致

content.stem_en: Which of the following are limitations of using search engines to screen adverse media? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Search engines have limited global language coverage
options_en.B: Search engines provide unstructured data that complicates media analysis
options_en.C: Search results are often inefficient in identifying relevant adverse media
options_en.D: The process is time-consuming and requires significant manual effort
options_en.E: Outcomes can be inconsistent due to varying search engine algorithms
